verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a Create Custom Control API alongside adding controls from the Vanta library, and deactivation that applies to both custom and Vanta controls. It also documents Custom Tests that turn pushed custom-resource data into pass/fail evidence, and mapping documents to controls as evidence. Custom frameworks are only implied by marketing copy about cross-mapping across pre-built frameworks "or ones you've customized," with no documented workflow for authoring a framework from scratch. Missing for 10: documented creation of fully custom frameworks, explicit definition of per-control evidence requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
